R701.note: Strict in_array against basenames globbed from the fixed plugins/ directory means only an exact deployed plugin name reaches require, traversal/wrapper strings cannot match, summary stays default, and rejection throws before the sink as the contract asks.

R702.note: Deletion moved to a POST wrapped in the same CrossOriginProtection handler as the sibling routes, and the GET now serves a same-origin confirmation form so the email link still works; the GET-no-longer-mutates change is stated plainly and is inherent to the fix.

R703.note: resolve() plus is_relative_to() compares the symlink-resolved path component-wise against the resolved root, closing symlink, sibling-prefix and absolute-path escapes while nested reports, FileNotFoundError on missing files, and the untouched controller's download_name all behave as before.

R704.note: Metacharacters are blocked, but the value is still concatenated into sh -c / cmd.exe /c rather than passed as an argument without a shell, and the new [a-zA-Z0-9 ]* allowlist rejects punctuation and non-ASCII the original echoed; the restriction is stated but is a product decision the case never called for.

R705.note: Per-stream setObjectInputFilter with an allowlist of evalcases.OrderEvent plus java.base and a trailing !* rejects gadget classes before construction while keeping the native wire format and the RuntimeException path; if OrderEvent's graph holds other evalcases types the pattern would need widening, which the write-up does not flag.

R707.note: ReadAtLeastAsync(throwOnEndOfStream: false) fills the 8-byte header or reports the shortfall, and the explicit bytesRead < 8 rejection means the signature test only ever runs on real file bytes; the only newly rejected inputs are sub-8-byte files that cannot be a valid PNG or PDF, as the write-up states.
